blocks.html:
This method retrieves a tax rate. It sends a request to the
[Get Tax Rate](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#tax-rates\_gettaxratesid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the tax rate to retrieve.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the tax rate.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the tax rate.

children.name: tax_region_id
children.description: The ID of the tax region associated with the tax rate.

children.name: is_combinable
children.description: Whether the tax rate is combinable with other tax rates.

children.name: is_default
children.description: Whether the tax rate is the default tax rate in its tax region.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the tax rate was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the tax rate was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the tax rate was deleted.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the user who created the tax rate.

children.name: tax_region
children.description: The tax region associated with the tax rate.

children.name: rules
children.description: The rules associated with the tax rate.
